Title: Login with valid credentials
Steps: 1. Enter username 2. Enter password 3. Click Login

Title: Login is rejected with the wrong password
Steps: 1. Enter username 2. Enter wrong password 3. Click Login
Expected Result: Error "Username and password do not match"; user stays on the login page

Title: Login with an empty password
Steps: 1. Enter username 2. Leave password empty 3. Click Login
